profile_text.body:
Box is a publicly traded company founded in 2005 and headquartered in Redwood City, CA, trading on the NYSE under the ticker BOX. The company describes itself as an Intelligent Content Management platform, offering tools for workflow automation, internal and external collaboration, and data protection in a single platform. Its site positions unstructured data, such as lease agreements, finance documents, sales presentations, and employee handbooks, as central to its use case.

Box AI is the company's primary AI product, categorized under notes, knowledge, and meetings, and covers enterprise content AI, metadata, governance, compliance, and retention policies. The site states that Box AI connects to leading AI models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google to deliver real-time summaries, deep analysis, and smart recommendations. Additional AI capabilities described on the site include Box AI Studio for building and customizing agents, a drag-and-drop workflow builder for deploying complex automations, deep learning-based malware detection, automated data classification, and AI-driven e-signature workflows with unlimited e-signatures offered at no additional cost. The site also notes compliance support for GDPR, HIPAA, and FINRA.

According to SEC filings, Box reported revenue of $1,177,253,000 for the period ending January 31, 2026, filed on Form 10-K under CIK 0001372612. No litigation is recorded in the held facts for this company.
